svg.title: Where are the Phi Phi Islands?
svg.desc: Regional map of southern Thailand from Natural Earth land data, with Phi Phi coastlines from OpenStreetMap. Phi Phi lies southeast of Phuket and south of the Krabi mainland in the Andaman Sea. Highlighted points locate the two principal islands. Coastlines are generalized. This is an educational map, not a navigation chart.

g.text: Where are the Phi Phi Islands?
Generalised coastlines · Educational map · Not for navigation
